meta.name: [LADA Decensored] Delivery NTR: Newlywed Housewife Suzu Honjo Attacked in Car by Veteran Driver
meta.description: The Honjo couple moved to the suburbs to start a business. To help with the household finances, the wife, Suzu, applied for a part-time job with a delivery company. While being trained step-by-step by an older veteran driver named Ozawa, she is eventually attacked after enduring extreme sexual harassment... However, when an affair between Ozawa's wife and Suzu's husband is discovered, the two of them drown in carnal desire to fill the void in their hearts...
